rows.label: Hellraiser service rifle
rows.paint:
A stamped-steel long-stroke assault rifle, the most common rifle pattern in the world. Pose: rifle diagonal, about 16 degrees, muzzle up and right, filling about 85% of the canvas width. Silhouette, kept exactly: a stamped steel receiver with a ribbed dust cover on top; a long gas tube above the barrel with a wooden upper handguard; a strongly curved, ribbed 30-round box magazine; a slanted muzzle brake; a tangent rear sight just in front of the dust cover and a front sight post on a triangular base near the muzzle; a large lever safety on the right side of the receiver; a wooden lower handguard, a separate pistol grip and a fixed wooden stock with a slight drop. Materials: dark blued and parkerised steel, warm reddish-brown wood with worn edges, steel rubbed bright at the edges and the magazine lips. Maker's touch: one muted oxide-red band (#CC2435) painted round the lower handguard. No bayonet.
At 32 px: the curved magazine, the gas tube over the barrel and the dropped wooden stock.

rows.label: Smetanita thumper
rows.paint:
A single-shot break-action 40 mm grenade launcher, the classic shoulder-fired one. Pose: diagonal, about 16 degrees, muzzle up and right, filling about 90% of the canvas width. Silhouette, kept exactly: a fat, short, wide barrel; a folding leaf sight standing up on top of the barrel; a break-action hinge in front of the trigger and a top lever; a slim wooden fore-end under the barrel; a wooden shoulder stock with a thick rubber pad. Materials: lacquered black metal, dark wood. Maker's touch: brass on the hinge and one small blank brass tag on the stock.
At 32 px: a fat stubby barrel on a slim wooden stock, with a leaf sight on top.

rows.label: Breacher tube

A reusable shoulder-fired recoilless rifle. Pose: diagonal, about 16 degrees, muzzle up and right, filling about 90% of the canvas width, drawn dense and heavy. rows.label: Hellraiser LMG
rows.paint:
The light machine gun of the stamped long-stroke rifle family: the line's service rifle lengthened. Pose: diagonal, about 16 degrees, muzzle up and right, filling about 90% of the canvas width, drawn dense and heavy. Silhouette, kept exactly: the same stamped receiver as the line's service rifle, with the ribbed dust cover and the large lever safety on the right; a long, heavier barrel running far past the handguard, with a plain slotted muzzle device; a folding bipod hinged near the muzzle, its two legs folded back along the barrel; a long gas tube with a wooden upper handguard and a wooden lower handguard; a long, strongly curved ribbed box magazine (longer than the rifle's); a tangent rear sight on the receiver; a fixed wooden stock with a deep club-foot butt. Materials: dark blued and parkerised steel, warm reddish-brown wood with hard scratches. Maker's touch: one muted oxide-red band (#CC2435) round the lower handguard. No trench spikes.
At 32 px: the service rifle's shape made long, with a bipod at the muzzle, a long curved magazine and a club-foot stock.

rows.label: .700 Blackpoint anti-materiel
rows.paint:
A huge semi-automatic anti-materiel rifle, the biggest rifle a person can fire. Pose: diagonal, about 16 degrees, muzzle up and right, filling about 90% of the canvas width, drawn dense and heavy. Silhouette, kept exactly: a very long flat two-part receiver; a long heavy barrel ending in a large arrowhead-shaped double-chamber muzzle brake; a top rail with a big scope; a carry handle; a folding bipod at the front of the receiver; a box magazine; a big recoil pad on the butt. Materials: grim dark grey steel, worn. Maker's touch: none; the muzzle brake scorched dark.
At 32 px: a very long flat rifle with an arrowhead muzzle and a bipod.
